original_question: Does LHCGR have more amino acids than GIPC1?

final_qi.question: How many amino acids does LHCGR have?
final_qi.long_answer: The human luteinizing hormone/choriogonadotropin receptor (LHCGR) is encoded by the LHCGR gene on chromosome 2p21 and the canonical protein sequence listed in UniProt (accession P22888) comprises exactly 699 amino acids, spanning an extracellular leucine-rich domain followed by seven transmembrane helices and an intracellular tail.

final_qi.question: How many amino acids does GIPC1 have?
final_qi.long_answer: The human GAIP-interacting protein, C-terminus 1 (GIPC1, also known as synectin) is encoded by the GIPC1 gene and the canonical protein sequence contains exactly 333 amino acids, as documented in reference protein databases such as UniProt (entry O14908).
